subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Following up on my earlier email about validated referrals for your comparison panel. Worth restating the market math: comparison sites here earn up to 15 percent on travel and up to 25 percent of premium on other lines (CHOICE), while digital acquisition for the underlying products runs roughly 305 dollars for auto and 328 dollars for travel cover (Focus Digital). On that thin referral margin, a handover that does not stick is paid demand wasted, and Finder benchmarks a web partner on exactly that handover quality. Worth comparing against your current mix?
angle: fresh angle: thin referral margin (up to 15 percent travel / 25 percent of premium, CHOICE) + AU digital insurance CAC ~305 auto / ~328 travel (Focus Digital)
register_notes: Stage 2 Australian English, native register, no transliteration (Latin script). Acknowledges second follow-up and references prior outreach in first sentence. Fresh angle = the referral-margin math reframed (comparison commission up to 15 percent travel / 25 percent of premium per CHOICE) against real web-verified AU digital insurance CAC ~305 auto / ~328 travel (Focus Digital), both carried over from the parent's verified sources. Rotates to Finder from brand_candidates as the quality bar; no brand outside the candidate set; no cross-border giant as a local rival. No MobUpps figure this stage (illustrative_flags empty). Exactly one question mark; no sign-off; no em dash; no curly quotes; no hedge before a number; 'X, not Y' avoided.
